I saved the draft to Tobias Rendle (trendle@pemberline.com) and replied to June in her direct message.

- **What the draft says:** The subject is "Tansley Parcel – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the rate as $1,313 a seat, as Pree gave it, and says the deal desk approved sharing it. I used the figure June stated, since she's the deal desk approver.
- **Approval:** June's message was the approval I asked for on 10/15, so no new approval request was needed. Tobias's address is on pemberline.com, so the outside-mail rule doesn't apply.
- **Nothing was sent:** A person has to send it.
- **Which mailbox:** The 10/15 request was for a draft from Ilse Varga's mailbox, but the mail tool saved it in June's mailbox. I told June so she can review and send it herself.
